Kye.bio: Kye Goff is a graphic designer who enjoys creating minimalist, clean, and simple work and is looking to branch out into a more primarily branding-focused background, as they want to help brands assert themselves and communicate to their audience what they represent. Even so, Kye remains open to creating posters and publications, as that is something they also enjoy working on. They can use a range of software such as Adobe and are also getting into photography as a supporting hobby to help further elevate their design work.

Rebecca.bio: Rebecca is a print-focused designer specialising in risograph, branding, and experimental design. Rooted in print culture, she creates bold, textured visuals using expressive typography and tactile processes to communicate through both concept and physical form. Her work often explores the relationship between materiality and message, using layering, colour separation, and print imperfections as intentional design elements. This approach allows her to produce outcomes that feel both contemporary and process-driven, with a strong emphasis on experimentation, visual impact, and the physical qualities of printed media.
